# Introduction {#sec-intro}

Difference-in-differences is one of the oldest and most widely used tools of applied
economics [@angrist2009]. Its best-known application is @card1994's study of the
minimum wage in New Jersey and Pennsylvania; @card1990 used the same logic to study the
Mariel boatlift, and it reached a wide audience through @levitt2005. @sec-did applies
it to the Night's Watch, and @sec-conclusion concludes.

## Objectives

State the research questions and contributions of the thesis here.
